name: In'ei ~Frame no Naka no Tenshi~
original_name: 淫影 ～フレームの中の天使～
source:
Main character is an up-standing photographer who takes up a job to provide a photo session for a lingerie shop. The three models are all cute girls, and there is also an astonishing shop owner. The sales of a new lingerie shop depend on how much girl charm you can draw with the photos.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-august-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一位正直的摄影师，接到了为一家内衣店提供拍摄服务的工作。三位模特都是可爱的女孩，还有一位令人惊艳的店主。新内衣店的销量取决于你能通过照片展现多少女孩的魅力。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-august-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
